name: Zilliz Cloud
line: Hosted vector database for similarity, filtered and hybrid search.

free.text: 5 GB storage; 2.5M vCUs/mo; 7 consecutive idle days to suspend; resumable

cells.regions: AWS, Google Cloud and Azure; availability varies by plan
cells.selfhost: No, managed cloud; Milvus is a separate product

sql.math: Free is $0 only if 2.5M vCUs (compute units) and 5 GB storage fit. The paid minimum for reads is 100,000 × 6 minimum vCUs × $4 per million = $2.40. Writes, storage, index overhead and transfer leave the total unknown.
Free is $0 if the data plus indexes fit within 5 GB. 0.7168 GB is raw data before index overhead. After 7 inactive days it suspends, and it can be resumed.

files.math: Managed Volumes are for imports and migrations, not general app file storage.

jobs.math: Zilliz Cloud does not provide a customer job or workflow runner.
